sql: SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, SUM(yt) as total_yt, SUM(anglers) as total_anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers), 4) as yt_per_angler FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 116 GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls
SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, SUM(yt) as total_yt, SUM(anglers) as total_anglers, COUNT(*) as boat_count FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 6 GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
